request: 使用实机水果且大小比例与实机一致；水果完整留在画面内，贴边与相邻处呈现轻微果冻挤压而非裁切。
operation: Programmatic compositing of the production fruit sprites. Radii are read from WatermelonGameplayConfig and scaled uniformly until the set jams inside a 24 px inset wall; the watermelon is pinned to the bottom-right corner. Every neighbour or wall contact gets a 7% mesh-warp flattening that keeps the sprite's own glossy rim.
sizing: 4:3; proportionally reduced to 568 × 426, the maximum cover display size of the shared loading dialog at the 750 × 1334 design resolution.

composition.background: sage gingham matching the in-game background c1-cat-room-bg-v1: pale cream centre, grey-teal vignette corners
composition.fruits: cherry, grape, strawberry, dekopon, orange, apple, pear, watermelon at in-game radius ratios
composition.watermelon: largest, pinned to the bottom-right corner against the right and bottom walls
composition.edges: All fruits fully inside a thin gingham strip; wall and neighbour contacts are flattened, never cropped.

deformation: 7% flattening per contact with slight sideways bulge.
